hook: Your road from Alaska to Argentina has a gap.
title: The Highway From Alaska to Argentina Has a Gap
description:
The Pan-American Highway runs through much of the Americas, but it stops in Panama and Colombia. The Darién Gap is about 100 km of jungle and swamp with no road across it.

Series: Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #Geography #DarienGap
comment_prompt: Would you cross it? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your road from Alaska to Argentina has a gap.
scenes.headline: ALASKA TO ARGENTINA

scenes.narration: It is called the Pan-American Highway.

scenes.narration: But in Panama and Colombia, it stops.
scenes.headline: THE ROAD STOPS

scenes.narration: That gap is the Darién Gap.
scenes.headline: DARIÉN GAP

scenes.narration: It is about a hundred kilometres of jungle and swamp.

scenes.narration: Travellers go around it by boat or air.

scenes.narration: So Alaska to Argentina still has a gap.
